jobs.title: Service and Operations Strategy Consultant (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a specialized, collaborative, and delivery-focused professional to advance the Service and Operational Strategy for Financial Protection and Retirement Solutions (FPRS). Reporting to the Service and Operations Strategy Leader, you will independently advance complex workstreams that turn strategy into results; translating roadmaps and operating-model designs into rigorous analysis, business cases, and implementation-ready plans across new business and inforce service, operations, and contact center functions. You will apply strong strategic, analytical, and problem-solving skills across current-state assessment, opportunity identification, business-case development, and operating-model design, applying autonomy to develop customized solutions and escalating the most complex tradeoffs. You will help convert strategic priorities into measurable operational outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:
- Conduct current-state analysis of operations, customer journeys, channel performance, service demand, and cost drivers, and translate findings into prioritized transformation opportunities.
- Evaluate strategic levers across automation, digital containment, workflow optimization, and AI-enabled solutions, including requirements definition, vendor and tool assessment, and impact sizing.
- Support the development of business cases, roadmaps, and implementation plans in partnership with technology, customer experience, finance, and operational leaders.
- Execute and lead complex or specialized analysis of outsourcing, managed service, nearshore/offshore, and hybrid delivery models, including cost-benefit modeling, risk assessment, and transition planning.
- Help define and document operating model requirements, including roles, governance, process ownership, controls, workforce impacts, and change management routines.
- Establish and track KPIs and success measures for transformation initiatives, and build the reporting that shows progress against targets.
- Prepare for and support cross-functional workshops and leadership discussions, driving alignment and capturing decisions, actions, and follow-through.
- Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, competitive practices, and customer behavior shifts to keep the operations strategy future-ready.
- Manage execution across multiple initiatives, coordinating timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder inputs to keep strategic priorities on track.

You are:
- Delivery-oriented: Experience independently executing strategic, transformation, or process-improvement initiatives from analysis through implementation.
- A fast learner: Able to quickly absorb new businesses, processes, and tools, and apply that understanding to solve problems.
- Driven: Brings energy and a hunger to make an impact, taking ownership and pushing initiatives forward.
- Strategic: Able to see the bigger picture, frame opportunities, and connect analysis to actionable recommendations and roadmaps.
- Analytical: Ability to analyze operational, financial, workforce, and customer data to identify opportunities, quantify impact, and influence recommendations.
- Collaborative: Proven ability to contribute to cross-functional initiatives, manage ambiguity, and support alignment across teams with competing priorities.
- A strong communicator: Ability to simplify complex topics, develop clear narratives, and present recommendations to leaders.
- Autonomous and accountable: Able to work independently with guidance in the most complex situations, applying sound judgment to develop customized solutions.

You have:
- Bachelor’s degree required.
- 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate or business strategy, operations strategy, transformation, or business process improvement.
- Strong analytical and project management skills, including proficiency with data, business case development, and executive-ready materials.
- Experience with operating-model transformation, including automation and AI platforms used to modernize processes.
- Familiarity with contact center, workforce planning, operations, and service functions is a plus.

You will:
- Help shape and execute the modernization of our service and operating model
- Develop a deep understanding of FPRS businesses, workflows, and processes
- Partner closely with operations leadership, contact center leaders, customer experience, workforce management, technology, procurement, and change management teams
- Be supported by the Service and Operations Strategy Leader while being empowered to independently drive workstreams, challenge the status quo, and grow into broader strategic responsibility

Salary Range:

$103,450.00 - $169,960.00

The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. jobs.title: Finance Transformation Lead
jobs.description:
Is the opportunity to join a culture where “We Do the Right Thing,” and “We Courageously Shape Our Future Together” important to you? If so, Guardian is seeking a motivated individual to join our team as a Finance Transformation Lead.

This role is responsible for driving strategic transformation initiatives across the Finance organization to improve performance, optimize processes, advance AI-enabled capabilities, and strengthen data-driven decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Finance & Risk Transformation, Strategy and Operations, s/he will partner closely with Finance, Technology, Risk, Operations, Data, and business leaders to design and implement future-state operating models, modernize planning and reporting processes, and deliver sustainable business value.

AI enablement is a core accountability

This leader will advance the organization's AI-enabled Finance strategy by embedding Generative AI, intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and agentic AI capabilities into Finance processes, operating models, and ways of working, while ensuring responsible adoption, governance, risk management, and measurable value realization.

You will
Key Responsibilities
Transformation Strategy & Execution
- Develop and execute Finance transformation strategies aligned with business and enterprise objectives.

- Lead large-scale transformation initiatives spanning Finance processes, operating models, systems, data, controls, and organizational capabilities.

- Manage transformation roadmaps, implementation plans, milestones, dependencies, and value realization objectives.

- Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, effectiveness, decision support, governance, and stakeholder experience.

- Drive continuous improvement and innovation across Finance functions.

AI Enablement & Digital Innovation
- Lead the Finance AI strategy and roadmap, identifying opportunities to leverage Generative AI, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and agentic AI solutions to improve productivity, decision-making, and business outcomes.

- Partner with Finance leaders to identify, prioritize, and scale high-value AI use cases across FP&A, forecasting, management reporting, expense management, financial close, workforce planning, and decision support.

- Drive adoption of enterprise AI capabilities, including Microsoft Copilot, Claude, AI agents, and emerging technologies, ensuring alignment with business priorities and governance expectations.

- Establish frameworks for AI use case intake, evaluation, prioritization, value realization, adoption measurement, and ongoing performance monitoring.

- Collaborate with Technology, Data, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Information Security teams to ensure responsible AI adoption and adherence to enterprise governance standards.

- Lead AI-related change management efforts, including communications, training, stakeholder engagement, and capability-building programs to increase AI literacy across Finance.

- Measure and track AI adoption, productivity gains, capacity creation, cost savings, decision quality improvements, and other business outcomes.

- Monitor emerging AI trends, technologies, and industry best practices, translating innovation into actionable opportunities for Finance.

Operating Model & Process Transformation
- Design and implement future-state Finance operating models, governance structures, and service delivery frameworks.

- Lead process optimization across FP&A, forecasting and budgeting, management reporting, financial close and consolidation, business performance management, expense management, and capital planning.

- Promote standardization, automation, simplification, and scalable ways of working across Finance processes.

- Assess organizational readiness, capability gaps, role impacts, and process changes required to sustain transformation outcomes.

Technology, Data & Analytics Enablement
- Partner with Technology and Data teams to lead implementation of Finance platforms, reporting solutions, analytics capabilities, and digital tools.

- Support transformation initiatives involving ERP modernization, Oracle Planning/EPM, enterprise performance management, reporting platforms, AI-enabled workflows, and automation solutions.

- Translate business requirements into technology-enabled solutions, user stories, process designs, and implementation roadmaps.

- Strengthen Finance data quality, consistency, transparency, and accessibility to support analytics, forecasting, and AI-enabled insights.

Stakeholder Management, Governance & Change Leadership
- Serve as a trusted advisor to Finance executives, senior stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.

- Facilitate executive workshops, strategic planning sessions, use case prioritization discussions, and operating model design conversations.

- Establish governance structures, reporting mechanisms, risk management routines, and escalation channels for transformation initiatives.

- Manage vendor, consulting partner, and cross-functional delivery relationships as required.

- Lead change management, communications, training, and stakeholder engagement activities that support adoption and sustained behavior change.

You have
Required Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.

- 8+ years of Finance, consulting, transformation, strategy, technology enablement, or program management experience.

- 5+ years leading large-scale Finance transformation initiatives or enterprise change programs.

- Experience leading AI, Generative AI, automation, digital transformation, or advanced analytics initiatives within Finance or related business functions.

- Demonstrated ability to identify, prioritize, and implement AI use cases that deliver measurable business value.

- Strong understanding of Finance operating models, planning, forecasting, reporting, expense management, and performance management processes.

- Experience developing transformation roadmaps, business cases, benefits realization plans, and executive-level presentations.

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, data, risk, and operations.

- Strong analytical, facilitation, problem-solving, communication, and executive storytelling skills.

Preferred Qualifications
- MBA, CPA, CFA, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, SAFe, or other relevant advanced degree or certification.

- Experience within Financial Services, Insurance, Banking, Risk Management, or other highly regulated industries.

- Experience implementing Oracle Planning, Oracle EPM Cloud, Hyperion, SAP, Workday, Anaplan, or similar Finance platforms.

- Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, agent-based AI solutions, workflow automation, or similar platforms.

- Knowledge of Responsible AI, AI governance, model risk management, data governance, privacy, information security, and adoption frameworks.

- Consulting experience with a leading management consulting firm or enterprise transformation practice.

Key Competencies
Strategic Leadership
Enterprise mindset, strategic planning, business acumen, vision-setting, prioritization, and decision-making.
Transformation Delivery
Program leadership, portfolio management, roadmap execution, risk management, change leadership, and benefits realization.
AI & Digital Enablement
Generative AI adoption, AI use case identification, intelligent automation, analytics, responsible AI practices, and innovation management.
Finance Expertise
FP&A, forecasting, reporting, performance management, expense management, operating model design, and process optimization.
Relationship Management
Executive presence, stakeholder influence, facilitation, cross-functional partnership, and communication.
Location
- Hybrid: 3 days a week in office - NYC, Hudson Yards; or Stamford CT. 2 days WFH

jobs.description:
We are currently seeking a strategic and collaborative Associate, Enterprise Strategy & Planning .

In the highly impactful role, you will help develop the long-range plans for Guardian and partner with key stakeholders to identify, develop, evaluate, prioritize and deliver strategic initiatives across the organization.  You will support internal consulting engagements to solve critical strategic questions for the Guardian Leadership Team, working with senior sponsors, business units, and corporate functions, while partnering closely with the rest of the Enterprise Strategy team.

A successful candidate will work across the Enterprise Strategy & Transformation team to provide strategic frameworks and deliver on critical strategy projects.  You will structure problem-solving, conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses of operational and financial data, and organize industry/ competitor research to continuously evaluate Guardian’s positioning.  You will also synthesize your findings for senior-level audiences through both written and verbal communications. This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to Guardian's business while creating pathways for long-term career development and internal mobility.

The role reports to Guardian’s Head of Enterprise Strategy & Planning.  You will partner closely with Guardian’s Corporate Development, AI Strategic Transformation, and Finance teams, as well as counterparts in business units and corporate functions.

Your work will span across:
Enterprise-wide strategy development – Work to define the strategic direction, with both near-term and long-term priorities for Guardian.  This will be supported by research, analytics, and logical problem solving and strategic frameworks.
Internal strategy consulting – working with a senior sponsor, execute deep-dive strategy projects on high priority topics for the business units and corporate functions
Strategic planning – support with the enterprise-wide processes that drive strategy, including objectives and target setting, portfolio planning, and quarterly progress updates.
Growth initiatives and innovation – assess or develop business cases for new ideas driving innovation, partnerships, and other areas of investment outside of BAU. Identify, frame, and implement specific cross-cutting strategic initiatives that are critical to the success of Guardian’s overall strategy.
Prepare materials for senior leadership –in partnership with the Enterprise Strategy team, develop agenda, content, and analysis for key strategic fora, including the annual Strategy Session of the Board and the annual Guardian Leadership Team Strategic Planning offsite

You are:
- A strategic problem-solver, with demonstrated experience in using frameworks and analysis to support data-driven recommendations
- Experienced in conducting analysis on short time frames and with limited data, in a consulting-style approach
- Highly organized and efficient, with ability to prioritize across multiple projects and competing demands at any given time
- An effective communicator (both oral and written) with ability to work well on cross-functional teams
- Results-oriented and pragmatic; looking to make real, tangible impact and ensure that recommendations can be effectively operationalized
- Proactive and resourceful, a self-starter
- Intellectually curious and innovation minded; always asking “what’s next?”

You have:

Required:
- Strong problem-solving skills
- Demonstrated experience with quantitative and qualitative analysis
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
- Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
- 3+ years’ experience working in roles related to strategy & management consulting within a top consulting firm or internal strategy within a financial services company
- Experience managing complex projects and/or timelines
- Bachelor’s degree from a top institution with strong academic performance and demonstrated leadership ability

You will:
- Work on interesting, complex strategic problems with a chance to make a tangible impact
- Get exposure to a variety of functions and businesses across Guardian
- Build a network of peers and collaborators across business units
- Receive hands-on mentorship and coaching from experienced leaders at Guardian

Location:
- This role is Hybrid with 3 days a week in our Hudson Yards NYC location

jobs.description:
2027 Guardian Summer Intern, Corporate Finance & Risk - FP&A and Management Reporting
Our 2027 Summer Internship Program is a paid 10-week learning experience where you will be immersed in the daily environment of a thriving global financial services company. You will gain invaluable industry and organizational knowledge through daily business interactions and job assignments, in addition to engaging in projects that directly affect our business, interact with senior leaders in conversational settings, and network with employees and interns across our offices. This 10-week internship provides you with realistic experiences and information of what it is like to work at Guardian.

Interns may have the opportunity to be considered for Guardian's Finance Leadership Development Program upon successful completion of the internship. We are seeking candidates who are curious, adaptable, and excited to gain exposure to different areas of the Finance and Risk organization.

Internship Dates:
The internship program will run from Thursday, May 27, 2027- Friday, August 6, 2027 .

jobs.title: Head of Operational Excellence and Enablement, Underwriting
jobs.description:
The Head of Operational Excellence and Enablement will drive strategic initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, effectiveness, and organizational readiness within the Group Benefits Underwriting organization. This role is accountable for optimizing learning and development, quality assurance programs, underwriting tools, data and operational metrics and capacity while ensuring leaders and teams are fully prepared to adopt new ways of working.

This leader will embed best practices, enable accurate and consistent decision-making, and cultivate a culture of continuous improvement while proactively preparing the organization for operational, technological, and capability change. A central responsibility of this role is to ensure underwriting excellence is achieved and sustained through strong execution, readiness, and adoption.

You Will
Operational Excellence & Enablement
- Drive innovation and continuous improvement as a core mindset across the underwriting organization.
- Develop and execute operational excellence strategies aligned to underwriting goals, enterprise priorities, and customer outcomes.
- Establish performance metrics, benchmarks, and KPIs to measure operational success, decision quality, and underwriting productivity.
- Utilize data analytics and underwriting tools to generate insights, inform decisions, and proactively optimize execution.
- Manage quality assurance programs that surface risk, consistency, and training needs—ensuring issues are addressed systematically and sustainably.
- Partner closely with cross-functional teams to help implement technology solutions and process changes that enhance underwriting workflows and decision-making.

Organizational Readiness & Change Leadership
- Act as a primary owner of organizational readiness for underwriting process, technology, and capability changes.
- Assess change impact and readiness across underwriting teams, translating operational initiatives into clear people, role, skill, and behavior implications.
- Lead and embed change enablement practices that ensure smooth adoption of new processes, tools, and operating models.
- Partner with underwriting leaders to strengthen change leadership capability, ensuring leaders actively sponsor, reinforce, and role-model new ways of working.
- Identify adoption risks and cultural barriers early, implementing mitigation strategies that support sustained behavioral change.
- Ensure operational improvements are reinforced through updated operating rhythms, performance expectations, governance, and training—not just documented outcomes.

Capability & Culture Building
- Design and implement best-in-class training programs that elevate underwriting capability, consistency, and decision quality.
- Provide ongoing support, tools, and resources that enable colleagues to work more efficiently and confidently.
- Engage stakeholders at all levels to foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and urgent execution.
- Instill a strong linkage between operational excellence, consumer-centricity, and underwriting excellence.

You Are
- A strategic, outcome oriented thinker with a strong focus on operational excellence and enablement.
- A people-oriented, change-capable leader who balances execution rigor with adoption and sustainability.
- Results-driven with a deep sense of accountability and ownership.
- Adaptable, pragmatic, and effective in evolving and complex environments.

You Have
- Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
- Minimum of 10 years of experience in underwriting, operations management, or a related field.
- Proven experience leading operational transformation, large-scale process improvement, and organizational enablement.
- Strong background in Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement methodologies.

Critical Skills
- People-oriented leader with exceptional ability to inspire teams and build high-performance cultures.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate insight into action.
- Excellent leadership and stakeholder engagement skills, including influencing at senior levels.
- Proficiency in data analysis, reporting tools, and operational performance management.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organizational and time management skills; ability to operate effectively under pressure.

The work arrangement for this role will be hybrid (3+ days per week in a Guardian office). Preferred locations include Boston, MA; Bethlehem, PA; and New York, NY.  We will consider remote candidates if experience is aligned .
